A consensus five-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] out of high school, Sharpe signed to play [[college basketball]] with the [[Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball|Kentucky Wildcats]], but did not play a game before leaving for the NBA. He was selected seventh overall in the [[2022 NBA draft]]. == Early life == Sharpe played basketball for [[H. B. == === Portland Trail Blazers (2022–present) === Sharpe was selected with the seventh overall pick in the [[2022 NBA draft]] by the [[Portland Trail Blazers]]. He joined the 6th overall pick, [[Bennedict Mathurin]], as the only Canadians drafted in the first round that year. On July 1, 2022, he signed his rookie-scale contract with the Trail Blazers.{{Cite web |date=July 1, 2022 |title=Trail Blazers Sign Shaedon Sharpe |url=https://www.nba.com/blazers/news/trail-blazers-sign-shaedon-sharpe |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220701171643/https://www.nba.com/blazers/news/trail-blazers-sign-shaedon-sharpe |archive-date=July 1, 2022 |access-date=July 1, 2022 |website=NBA}} On July 8, in his [[2022 NBA Summer League|NBA Summer League]] debut, Sharpe suffered a shoulder injury after under six minutes of play. An MRI later revealed a small labral tear in his left shoulder, and Sharpe was unable to play for the rest of the Summer League.{{Cite web |date=July 9, 2022 |title=Blazers rookie Sharpe has labral tear in shoulder |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/34218518 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220712020516/https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/34218518 |archive-date=July 12, 2022 |access-date=July 12, 2022 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}} On October 19, he made his NBA debut, scoring 12 points in a 115–108 win over the [[2022–23 Sacramento Kings season|Sacramento Kings]].{{Cite web |last=Dubow |first=Josh |date=October 20, 2022 |title=GRANT RALLIES BLAZERS PAST KINGS 113-108 IN OPENER |url=https://www.nba.com/game/0022200014 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221020054022/https://www.nba.com/game/0022200014 |archive-date=October 20, 2022 |access-date=December 10, 2022 |website=NBA}} On March 29, 2023, in a loss against the Kings, Sharpe recorded 30 points along with seven rebounds and seven assists, and joined [[LeBron James]], [[Kevin Durant]], and [[Luka Dončić]] as the only teenagers to ever achieve such numbers in a game.{{Cite web |last=Fentress |first=Aaron |date=2023-03-31 |title=Trail Blazers rookie Shaedon Sharpe joins rare company |url=https://www.oregonlive.com/blazers/2023/03/trail-blazers-rookie-shaedon-sharpe-joins-rare-company.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230403225454/https://www.oregonlive.com/blazers/2023/03/trail-blazers-rookie-shaedon-sharpe-joins-rare-company.html |archive-date=2023-04-03 |access-date=2023-04-03 |website=OregonLive |language=en}} On February 9, 2024, Sharpe underwent abdominal surgery. On April 9, the team announced that Sharpe would miss the remainder of the season.{{cite web |last=Fentress |first=Aaron |title=Trail Blazers’ Shaedon Sharpe to miss rest of season |url=https://www.heraldandnews.com/sports/trail-blazers-shaedon-sharpe-to-miss-rest-of-season/article_fa2b5478-f6cb-11ee-a40c-6f7f9c9df97d.html |website=Herald and News |access-date=30 September 2024 |language=en |date=9 April 2024}} On September 30, 2024, Sharpe was cleared for training camp after undergoing abdominal surgery.{{cite web |title=Trail Blazers' Shaedon Sharpe: Cleared for training camp |url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/trail-blazers-shaedon-sharpe-cleared-for-training-camp/ |website=CBSSports.com |access-date=30 September 2024 |language=en |date=30 September 2024}} He made 72 appearances (52 starts) for Portland during the [[2024–25 NBA season]], averaging 18.5 points, 4.5 rebounds, and 2.8 assists. On October 19, 2025, Sharpe and the Trail Blazers agreed to a four-year, $90 million contract extension.{{cite web |last=Charania |first=Shams |author-link=Shams Charania |date=2025-10-19 |title=Agents: Blazers' Sharpe, Camara reach extensions |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/46652523/trail-blazers-toumani-camara-reach-4-year-extension-agent-says |access-date=2025-12-06 |website=ESPN.com}} On February 24, 2026, Sharpe was ruled out for 4-to-6 weeks due to a [[stress fracture|stress reaction]] in his left [[fibula]].{{Cite web|title=Trail Blazers injury update: Sharpe to miss at least 4-6 weeks with stress reaction in left leg|url=https://www.kgw.com/article/sports/nba/blazers/trail-blazers-shaedon-sharpe-injury-update/283-9ca1a8a4-fa3f-4008-8317-baae6e3d400e|access-date=July 13, 2026|website=kgw.com|language=en}} == National team career == Sharpe represented Canada at the [[2019 FIBA Under-16 Americas Championship]] in Brazil. He averaged 13 points, 3.7 rebounds and 2.3 assists, helping his team win the silver medal.{{Cite web |last=Vaught |first=Larry |date=February 16, 2021 |title=UK recruiting target Shaedon Sharpe has goals he pursues every day |url=https://www.yoursportsedge.com/2021/02/16/uk-recruiting-target-shaedon-sharpe-has-goals-he-pursues-every-day/vaughts-views/larryvaught/ |url-status=live
